headline: Nevish Line Erupts as Heavy Combat Grips Northern Fronts
war_summary: Nevish Line has exploded into furious contention over the latest hours, recording fifteen base transitions in the past two hours alone as heavy fighting engulfs Blackcoat Way, Blinding Stones, and Princefal amid sharply accelerating casualty rates. Callahan's Passage continues to endure massive frontline slaughter, sustaining over twelve hundred combined casualties an hour alongside steady troop arrivals. In Linn of Mercy, combat tempo has sharply quickened, yielding four fresh base events and pushing three strategic positions into no-man's-land as forces clash over Lathair and Outwich Ranch. Weathered Expanse remains heavily contested with four destroyed bases lying in ruin, though recent turnover has slowed compared to earlier hours. Meanwhile, Stonecradle reports accelerating casualty and enlistment rates around The Reach, whereas activity in Marban Hollow and Mooring County has stabilized into a steadier grind following earlier bouts of rapid base turnover. Outlying sectors across the south and east remain quiet, leaving the war's primary friction concentrated along this turbulent northern belt.
